claim.claim-text: 1. A dibenzoazepine compound for use in inhibiting or treating an infection of a subject with a pathogen that interacts with a complement receptor 3 (CR3) polypeptide-expressing cell, wherein the pathogen is selected from a Neisseria species and a retrovirus, and the dibenzoazepine compound is a dibenzoazepine compound of Formula (I):

2. The method, composition or article of claim 1, wherein the dibenzoazepine compound is selected from carbamazepine, oxcarbazepine, eslicarbazepine acetate, clomipramine, desipramine, imipramine, imipraminoxide, lofepramine, metapramine, opipramol, quinupramine and trimipramine.
3. The method, composition or article of claim 1, wherein the dibenzoazepine compound is carbamazepine.
4. The dibenzoazepine compound for use according to any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein the Neisseria species is Neisseria gonorrhoeae.
5. The dibenzoazepine compound for use according to claim 4, wherein the pathogen is resistant to an antimicrobial, preferably wherein the pathogen is resistant to an antibiotic.
6. The dibenzoazepine compound for use according to any one of claims 1 to 3, wherein the retrovirus is human immunodeficiency virus (HIV).
7. The dibenzoazepine compound for use according to any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the dibenzoazepine compound is formulated for oral delivery.
8. The dibenzoazepine compound for use according to any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the dibenzoazepine compound is formulated for systemic delivery.
9. The dibenzoazepine compound for use according to any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the dibenzoazepine compound is formulated for topical delivery.

10. The dibenzoazepine compound for use according to claim 9, wherein the dibenzoazepine compound is formulated as a cream, a foam, a wash, a lotion, a spray, a gel, a suppository, a pessary, an ointment, an ovule, a tampon, a glove, a male condom, a female condom, an intrauterine device, an intravaginal barrier, a vaginal dispenser, a vaginal ring, an intravaginal sponge, or aerosol.
11. The dibenzoazepine compound for use according to claim 9 or 10, wherein the dibenzoazepine compound is formulated for intrauterine delivery.
12. The dibenzoazepine compound for use according to any one of claims 1 to 11, wherein the dibenzoazepine compound is to be administered concurrently with an antimicrobial agent.

13. The dibenzoazepine compound for use according to claim 12, wherein the antimicrobial agent is selected from antibiotics, antifungals, antiprotozoals, antimalarials, antituberculotics and antivirals.
